name: cable standing reverse curl (sz bar)
description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a cable SZ bar. It targets the brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up while keeping your wrists straight.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.
